content: ABOUT US Legora is redefining how legal work gets done. Not built for lawyers, built with them. We work alongside the world’s best legal teams, who expect excellence, precision, and speed, and we hold ourselves to the same bar. Our AI-native workspace lets legal professionals move faster, think more clearly, and operate with sharper precision. By analysing thousands of documents in minutes and powering end-to-end workflows, we cut through complexity, teams can focus on what matters: judgment, strategy, and outcomes. 2,100+ customers across 80+ countries trust us, including Cleary Gottlieb, Goodwin, Linklaters, White & Case, Dentons, and Barclays. We’ve scaled to $200M+ in ARR, with teams across Europe, North America and APAC, and continue to expand through acquisitions including Qura, Walter AI, Graceview, Cadastral, and Wexler. We partner with world-class performers: including Aaron Judge and the New York Yankees, Ludvig Åberg (and his caddie), and campaigns featuring Jude Law. Joining Legora means three things. - We lean in: ownership over titles, outcomes over intentions. - We fight for excellence: high standards, direct, ego-free feedback. - We grow together: as a team and with our customers. Mission before ego. Everyone contributes. No one coasts. If you’re driven by impact, pace, and raising the bar. This is the place. THE ROLE Strategic Initiatives is a small team of generalists within Operations. We take on a few important, urgent problems at a time: ones that cross teams and don’t have a natural owner. We help solve them, then move on. Either the work is done, or we hand what needs to keep running to a long-term owner. The work takes three forms: - Solve business problems. Get to the bottom of an important question, help leaders decide what comes next and put the decision into practice. - Build new teams and ways of working. Set up a function, process or operating model from scratch, sometimes as the first person doing the work, and hand it over once it can run on its own. - Lead major programs. Our customers trust us with highly sensitive information and expect us to demonstrate how we protect it. As we grow across markets, our governance, risk and compliance program needs to keep pace with the business and the scrutiny that comes with it. We're looking for a Senior Manager or Director of GRC to lead that function. You will set the direction, develop the team and take responsibility for the quality and execution of our risk, compliance and assurance programs. You'll work closely with our CIO and leaders across Security, Engineering, Legal and the business to turn complex requirements into clear decisions and effective controls.
